headline: Jamaat expels four members over attack on journalists in Dhanmondi
summary: The party took action following an internal investigation into the assault of reporters during the Awami League's founding anniversary.
details: Jamaat-e-Islami has expelled four individuals for assaulting journalists in Dhaka’s Dhanmondi. The decision was announced on Wednesday following the recommendations of an internal investigation committee.
caption:
Four Jamaat-e-Islami members expelled after assaulting journalists in Dhanmondi.

Jamaat-e-Islami has expelled four individuals for assaulting journalists in Dhaka’s Dhanmondi. The decision was announced on Wednesday following the recommendations of an internal investigation committee.

headline_marked: Army operation in Khagrachhari: [[One killed, weapons recovered]]
headline: Army operation in Khagrachhari: One killed, weapons recovered
summary: The Bangladesh Army conducted an operation in Khagrachhari, resulting in the death of one individual and the recovery of firearms and ammunition.
details: The Bangladesh Army conducted a security operation in Khagrachhari, which resulted in the death of one person.
According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), the army recovered a significant amount of weapons and ammunition during the raid.
Other reports indicate that the members of the United People's Democratic Front (UPDF) were involved in the incident, with some sources claiming two members were killed and one was detained.
The operation was part of a broader effort to maintain law and order in the Chittagong Hill Tracts region.
caption:
One person killed and weapons recovered during an Army operation in Khagrachhari.

The Bangladesh Army conducted a security operation in Khagrachhari, which resulted in the death of one person.

According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), the army recovered a significant amount of weapons and ammunition during the raid.

Other reports indicate that the members of the United People's Democratic Front (UPDF) were involved in the incident, with some sources claiming two members were killed and one was detained.

The operation was part of a broader effort to maintain law and order in the Chittagong Hill Tracts region.
